slug: 2026-07-14 OUT, PDPC Launch National Data Protection Programme

facts.fact: Media Wire Express reports on 14 July 2026 a programme under the Personal Data Protection Act as the legal framework for protecting privacy.
The Open University of Tanzania and the PDPC launched a Certified Data Protection Officer programme in which the university trains and assesses and the PDPC certifies.
The PDPC, led by Director General Dr Emmanuel Mkilia, certifies data protection officers under a programme launched with the Open University of Tanzania on 14 July 2026.
